Date of service or date of discharge is within 181 days

payment_plan.quote: The payment plan may not exceed four (4) percent of the patient's monthly household income. For bills from health care professionals, the limit is two (2) percent of the monthly household income. Once 36 payments have been made, the remainder of the bill is forgiven and cease any and all collection activities on any balance that remains unpaid

notes: QCCP excludes: experimental/non-USFDA approved treatments, nursing home care, elective non-medically necessary surgeries, chiropractic, court ordered procedures, non-urgent dental, abortions except where required by law, cosmetic surgery, mental health services as primary diagnosis, CU Sports Medicine services.
QCCP ineligible: applicants in custody of law enforcement, college students from outside Colorado/US for higher education, visitors from other states/countries, FPL over 250%.

WeCare excludes: cosmetic procedures with packaged pricing, audiology supplies, lab kit draw fees, venipuncture fees and outpatient TB skin tests (unless with other BCH lab services), procedures already discounted to prevailing market rates (UCR), all outpatient pediatric and adult rehabilitation and behavioral health services, CU Sports Medicine services, high-cost implantable devices/drugs (discounted to BCH cost if not donated), services not covered/medically necessary by QCCP/Colorado Medicaid, elective care outside BCH service area, FPL over 350%.
WeCare ineligible: applicants in custody of law enforcement, applicants who qualify for Health First Colorado or CHP+, applicants receiving scheduled/elective services outside Colorado/US.
HDC ineligible: applicants residing outside Colorado, FPL over 251% (policy states 251% but eligibility says at or under 250%).
HDC covered services: emergent and medically necessary services in a Health Care Facility; services by Licensed Health Care Professionals in these settings also covered.
Multiple discounts not allowed: financial assistance discounts (QCCP, WeCare, HDC) cannot combine with employee discount, Medical Staff discount, or Self-Pay pricing discounts.

Self-pay 20% professional services discount excludes: actual vaccine/drug products, implantable devices, equipment/supplies/DME, remote Device Checks, services with different self-pay fee structure (Boulder Heart Diagnostics, CU Sports Therapy).
Self-pay 50% facility rate reversed if patient requests insurance billing; insurance then billed per contractual agreement.

Health share plans: BCH does not participate unless health share uses in-network plan; otherwise patient considered uninsured. Patient must bill health share and receive determination before applying for financial assistance.
QCCP payment plan: up to 4% monthly household income (2% for professional bills); balance forgiven after 36 payments.
HDC payment plan: up to 4% monthly household income (2% for professional bills); balance forgiven after 36 payments and all collection activities cease.

WeCare payment arrangement: interest-free tiers: $50-$499.99 up to 6 months; $500-$999.99 up to 12 months; $1,000-$2,499.99 up to 18 months; $2,500-$4,999.99 up to 24 months (auto-pay required); $5,000+ up to 36 months (auto-pay required).
QCCP application window: service date or discharge date (whichever later) within 181 days of application.
HDC application window: date of service or discharge within 181 days.
QCCP documentation deadline: 45 calendar days to submit required documentation.
WeCare documentation deadline: 30 calendar days to submit required documentation.
Homeless applicants exempt from income documentation requirements for QCCP, HDC, and WeCare.
WeCare requires Medicaid/CHP+/Medicare denial letter (dated within 45 days) if patient appears eligible for those programs; denial due to refusal to provide documentation not sufficient.
WeCare income calculation includes liquid assets (checking, savings, investments, stocks, bonds, trust funds, money market, CDs) plus household income and family size.
QCCP income calculation uses household income and family size only.
HDC income calculation uses household income and family size only.
BCH determines eligibility within 14 days of receiving request and all required documentation.
BCH provides refund if payments exceed approved financial assistance rate and established copayment for applications received during application period per §1.501(r)-1(b)(3).
BCH annually reviews and incorporates federal poverty guidelines updates from HHS.
AGB percentage calculated and updated annually per facility/provider; available on Addendum A.
Policy applies to BCH employed providers/practices providing services within covered facility per Addendum A.
EMTALA exception: no delay of medical screening exam, stabilizing treatment, or transfer; no financial discussions until patient assessed and treated per EMTALA policy.
Exceptions: Approved Single Case Agreements, clinical trial/grant participants, patients approved/pending HDC approval.
Family definition: for 18+, spouse/domestic partner and dependent children under 21; for under 18, parent/caretaker relative and other children under 21 of that relative.
Students claimed as dependents on parents' taxes screened on parents' income with patient in family size; proof of tax return required if student NOT claimed on parents' taxes.
For Social Security recipients, WeCare uses amount deposited into checking/savings or Direct Express debit card (after deductions).

payment_plan.quote: Payment plans that are established to pay the bills may not exceed four (4) percent of the patient's monthly household income.

notes: AGB rate varies by facility and provider; see Addendum A for specific percentages.

Excluded services for Qualified Charity Care Program include experimental/non-USFDA approved treatments, nursing home care, elective non-medically necessary surgeries, chiropractic, court ordered procedures, non-urgent dental, abortions except where required by law, cosmetic surgery, mental health services as a primary diagnosis, and CU Sports Medicine services.

Excluded services for WeCare include cosmetic procedures with packaged pricing, audiology supplies, lab kit draw fees, venipuncture fees, outpatient TB skin tests if not performed with other BCH lab services, procedures already discounted to prevailing market rates (UCR), all outpatient pediatric and adult rehabilitation services, all outpatient behavioral health services, CU Sports Medicine services, high-cost implantable devices and drugs, and services not covered or deemed medically necessary by Qualified Charity Care Program and/or Colorado Medicaid.
For WeCare, applicants over income threshold for Qualified Charity Care Program with adjusted household income between 250% and 350% FPL are eligible.
For WeCare, applicants who qualify for Health First Colorado or CHP+ are ineligible.
For WeCare, applicants that received scheduled/elective services and reside outside of Colorado or the United States are ineligible.
For Hospital Discounted Care, ineligible applicants include those that reside outside of Colorado and those with FPL over 251%.

Covered services for Hospital Discounted Care include emergent and medically necessary services received in a Health Care Facility and services provided by Licensed Health Care Professionals in these settings.

Patients who do not submit all required documentation within 45 calendar days may need to submit updated documentation to complete the application for Qualified Charity Care Program and Hospital Discounted Care.
Patients who do not submit all required documentation within 30 calendar days may need to submit updated documentation to complete the application for WeCare.
Once 36 payments have been made under a payment plan, the remainder of the bill is forgiven and collection activities cease on any remaining unpaid balance.
For bills from health care professionals, the payment plan limit is two (2) percent of the monthly household income.
Multiple discounts are not allowed; a financial assistance discount cannot be combined with any other discount offered by the hospital.
